ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:0.85 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous patch along the left distal leading edge; sparse white clusters localized on the right distal tip; primary fluke body consists of uniform low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central pixel angle of approximately 58 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box offset.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 2-8 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending dorsolaterally from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white pixels on the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct vertical high-intensity linear disruption visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical linear scar on the right lobe and significant concentrated scarring/pigmentation loss on both distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical white pigmentation pattern localized exclusively on the left leading edge compared to the right.
